spec.problem: The legacy learner /:locale/profile route is an active alias to /:locale/me, but its anonymous routing, real authenticated rendering and mobile behavior are not yet inventoried.

acceptance.text: Visible anonymous /vi/profile follows /vi/me to localized Login with returnTo and shows no private profile.
A learner registered and logged in through the actual visible UI can open /vi/profile and see the profile overview plus key tabs; vi/en/ja alias URLs preserve locale.
At 390x844 the authenticated profile overview and navigation tabs have no horizontal overflow or clipped controls.
The authenticated overview loads learner totals from GET /api/analytics/learner and due-card count from GET /api/flashcards/reviews/due; it does not call the nonexistent /api/learner/analytics route.

spec.expected_behavior: All supported locales preserve the alias destination; anonymous users are routed through localized login without profile data; a real learner session reaches the profile overview and the mobile profile controls stay within 390px.
spec.observed_behavior: Source redirects /:locale/profile to /:locale/me and /me is wrapped in RequireAuth; verify the actual redirect chain and authenticated page in the visible browser.
spec.rollback_plan: Audit-only change; revert only the inventory/report/task evidence if a recorded verdict is incorrect.

classification.rationale: This task records source-driven screen audit evidence and inventory status only; no product behavior is being changed.
